question: Which of the following pairs of values is a solution of the system \(\begin{cases}x+y=5\\2x-y=1\end{cases}\)?
solution: A solution must satisfy both equations simultaneously. All four pairs satisfy \(x+y=5\), but only \(x=2\), \(y=3\) satisfies \(2x-y=4-3=1\).
